facts.fact: Emily 没把和年长男人的事告诉室友，不是不信任，而是不想听她们评判。
facts.anchor: not because she didn’t trust them – she was undecided on that – but because she didn’t care to hear their judgements

facts.fact: Otley Road 的房子属于 Alice 父母，其他人按“朋友价”付租，因此欠着 Alice 人情，只能容忍她。
facts.anchor: an awkward fact that obliged the others to tolerate her more than they might have done

facts.fact: Alice 指责 JJ 白住不付钱，尽管在她口中 JJ 家里很有钱。
facts.anchor: Alice accused JJ of freeloading, despite him being supposedly minted in her words.

facts.fact: JJ 把同一个女友叫过 Becca、Becky、Jessie 三个名字，说她现在在国外读书。
facts.anchor: The girlfriend – whom he had variously referred to as Becca, Becky and Jessie – apparently now studied abroad.

facts.fact: Matty 有时坐在她那张最大的前卧室床尾，帮她做作业，尽管她学历史、他学英语。
facts.anchor: Sometimes Matty would sit at the end of her bed in the front bedroom, the biggest, and help her with her assignments

facts.fact: Emily 对 Matty 只字未提自己和 Berkeley 博士的私情。
facts.anchor: she had told him nothing of her liaisons with Dr Berkeley

facts.fact: JJ 在争吵中说 Alice 容忍 Emily 欠租，是因为 Alice 对 Emily 有种“瘆人的女生暗恋”。
facts.anchor: then JJ says the reason she lets you get away with it is because she has this creepy girl crush on you

facts.fact: 听完室友的争吵，Emily 的思绪飘回 Bradford、Aiden、酒吧角落和之后在车里做的事。
facts.anchor: Her mind drifted back to Bradford, to Aiden and their corner in the pub, to what they did later in the car.
